specDepartures.spec: Change: Go's strikethrough follows micromark-extension-gfm-strikethrough: an opener pairs only with a closer of the same length (1 or 2), and an escaped tilde is text.
specDepartures.plan: Besides the tilde rule, pmdoc takes the delimiter pairing over from goldmark (own list, per-kind links) and pairs `~` and `*`/`_` in micromark's order (separate passes, first run tokenized first, `~` first inside labels and pairs); the renderer keeps a goldmark-rules reader so correctly stored renderings keep their bytes.
specDepartures.evidence: Prototype at 4bbb2a9c: the tilde rule alone makes Parse quadratic (`~~a `x16000+`a~ `x16000: 4.23 s) and main is already quadratic on mixed runs (3.83-4.18 s at 112 KB); owned pairing: 71-86 ms. differential.sh over 20,000 generated paragraphs: without the renderer rule churn 352 / engine-tree churn 530; with it 3 / 6 (alt text); one regression `> **\~~](u)![_![~_` needs micromark's order. The INFRA-138 architect chose option A (Envoy, 2026-10-27 01:37Z).

outcome.scope: Adds micromark's pairing order across `~` and `*`/`_` (taken from INFRA-535, which keeps only the `~` attention-marker classification), linear pairing on mixed `~`/`*` runs including two shapes already quadratic at main, and the renderer's goldmark-rules byte-stability reading for tildes and image alt text.
